en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side shows a black-and-white photograph of a large building complex surrounded by dense forest, sited on an elevation above a river. There is a text in red 'Hussborgs Rekreationshem' and a handwritten date 'd. 10-6-08'. The reverse side has handwritten correspondence in Swedish, stamped with a green Swedish stamp (5 öre) postmarked 1908, and is addressed to a recipient in Stockholm.
